comment: KEYNOTE-355 as the off-trial rank 1 quietly skips the patient's prefers_trials=true setting. TROPION-Breast05 (NCT06103864) hands her the same regimen as its control arm with a 50% shot at the experimental TROP2-ADC + durvalumab arm, so the trial route is strictly dominant on expected value once the CPS gate clears. The conservative posture is right on safety dossier depth, but the preference file is asking for the trial slot first and the off-trial backbone as the fallback, not the reverse.

Ranking olaparib monotherapy at the top on pure evidence-quality grounds reads past two preference axes at once. The free-text framing is explicit that the operative goal is curative-intent strategy ('resection/ablation of solitary liver lesion after systemic conversion'), and prefers_trials=true asks the board to surface registrational slots before the FDA-label monotherapy. A 1L single-agent PARPi is the right answer for an evidence-only audit and the wrong answer for a 42-year-old whose preference set is explicitly weighted toward an aggressive first move; TROPION-Breast05 or the somatic-talazoparib Stanford trial (NCT03990896) belongs above OlympiAD here.

This pick recommends against the exact intervention the preference file's free-text was written to enable. The intake note says verbatim 'curative-intent strategy plausible (resection/ablation of solitary liver lesion after systemic conversion)', and the patient's efficacy lean (0.7) plus prefers_trials=true means the consensus-aligned route is the registered MSK consolidation protocol (NCT05534438) after documented response, not a recommendation-against. E2108 and NRG-BR002 are the right anchors to argue against off-trial SBRT, but they do not support overriding the patient's stated framing when a trial slot exists.

I am with the risktaker on TROPION-Breast05 at rank 1 and SBRT on the MSK protocol, but MEDIOLA-style olaparib + durvalumab maintenance at rank 2 reads as off-label single-arm n=34 dressed up as a registrational option, and prefers_trials=true wants an actually-enrolling slot in that seat. KEYLYNK-009 as the comparator anchor was negative overall, and payer pushback in 1L US TNBC is real even before the BRCA reversion-ctDNA baseline gets drawn. The somatic-talazoparib Stanford trial (NCT03990896) or TROPION-Breast02 (NCT05374512) as the CPS-low contingency fills the same expected-value slot through a registered enrollment instead of an off-label combination.

Dato-DXd carries ILD ~10% any-grade and ~2% G>=3 across the cumulative deruxtecan dataset, and durvalumab adds pneumonitis ~3-5% any-grade; the overlapping pulmonary-tox stack has no dedicated combination safety readout from TROPION-Breast05 yet. The advocate's 'downside bounded by the control arm' framing is correct on efficacy but skips the asymmetric pulmonary risk on the experimental arm. I will not block enrollment, but the rank 1 needs a baseline HRCT, PFTs, and a documented ILD-management algorithm in the consent before cycle 1.

Calling talazoparib evidence-quality parity with olaparib is defensible on the phase 3 numbers, but treating the G>=3 anemia 39% vs 16.1% gap as a 'tolerability not evidence-quality' aside understates it. EMBRACA reported dose reductions in 53% and transfusion in ~38% of patients versus 25% and ~17% on OlympiAD, which materially compresses dose intensity over a 12-18 month horizon in a 42-year-old. Keep talazoparib as the contingency if olaparib intolerance emerges, not at rank parity.

SG monotherapy runs G>=3 neutropenia 51% and febrile neutropenia 6% in ASCENT with primary G-CSF prophylaxis now in the label, and stacking pembrolizumab adds irAE pneumonitis ~3%, colitis ~2%, and hypothyroidism ~15%. The ASCENT-04 G>=3 TRAE distribution is higher than the KEYNOTE-355 chemo+pembro arm at the primary readout, and the Feb 2026 NCCN elevation rests on PFS plus QoL with OS still immature. Category 1 is appropriate; the rank 2 position ahead of KEYNOTE-355 needs an explicit G-CSF primary-prophylaxis plus irAE-surveillance precondition that the consensus framing does not surface.

Veto. ZEN-3694 layered on pembrolizumab plus nab-paclitaxel stacks three independent myelosuppressive mechanisms with no dedicated combination safety dataset: BET-i G>=3 thrombocytopenia ~20-30% from prior single-agent breast and prostate work, nab-paclitaxel G>=3 neutropenia ~30%, and pembrolizumab irAE burden including pneumonitis ~3% on top. The trial is n~60 dose-finding with no published efficacy and no characterized AE algorithm for the triplet, and the risktaker's own rationale concedes the cumulative tox stack is real. Veto contingent on the absence of a published combination safety dossier; if dose-expansion safety with G-CSF primary prophylaxis and an irAE-management algorithm is later published, the veto lifts to qualified.

The advocate rationale anchors expected value on TROPION-Breast02 PFS HR 0.57 (n=644, CPS<10 / ICI-ineligible, vs investigator's-choice chemo) and translates it onto TROPION-Breast05 (CPS>=10, vs KEYNOTE-355 pembro+chemo) — different population, different comparator, no published Breast05 experimental-arm efficacy yet. Enrolling on the trial is reasonable, but quoting PFS HR 0.57 as the forward bet on the experimental arm is cross-trial extrapolation, not a Breast05 readout. The honest framing is 'mechanistically aligned phase 3 slot with no primary readout in hand,' which is a different evidence claim.

KEYNOTE-355 is a legitimate rank-1 candidate, but ranking it above PARP-i in a patient with a BRCA1 finding (germline status in-flight on target_validation) understates the replication count. OlympiAD (n=302, PFS HR 0.58, 95% CI 0.43-0.80) and EMBRACA (n=431, PFS HR 0.54, 95% CI 0.41-0.71) are two independent phase 3 hits with low RoB 2 in this patient's biomarker-defined population; KEYNOTE-355 is a single phase 3 gated on a CPS read that is also pending. If germline BRCA1 confirms before CPS resolves, the evidence-quality call inverts the rank order.

The ASCENT-04 evidence row in this dossier sits at pmid:null, doi:null, with a 'currently in press' note. Rank 2 here rests on conference data plus a Feb 2026 NCCN category-1 elevation, not a peer-reviewed primary publication, and OS was immature at the PFS readout. The biology and the PFS HR 0.65 are plausible; the position above KEYNOTE-355 is appropriate once the manuscript locks and the OS interim reads, and premature until then.

MEDIOLA is n=34, single-arm, DCR at 12 weeks as the primary surrogate, no comparator. Citing KEYLYNK-009 BRCA1/2-mut PFS HR 0.70 as a third independent hit overstates the data — KEYLYNK-009 was negative overall (HR 0.98, 95% CI 0.72-1.33, p=0.46) and the BRCA-mut subgroup HR 0.70 has a 95% CI of 0.33-1.48 that crosses 1, in a stratum that was not powered. TOPACIO's 47% ORR is the BRCA-mut subset of n=15. This is a subset-of-subset stack of single-arm signals layered on a negative randomized parent trial, not three independent replications; the rank-2 position misreads the evidence weight.

TROPION-Breast05 is a registrational slot, not a guideline-endorsed regimen. NCCN Breast Cancer v2.2026 (Feb 27 2026 update) lists Dato-DXd + ICI nowhere as a 1L option; the trial's control arm is KEYNOTE-355 chemo+pembro, which is now the second category 1 backbone for CPS>=10 after sacituzumab govitecan + pembrolizumab took the preferred slot on ASCENT-04. Honoring prefers_trials=true is fine, but framing the experimental arm as the highest expected-value play conflates 'open phase 3 slot' with 'guideline-endorsed regimen,' and the rationale never separates the two.

Two issues with the rank order rather than the regimen itself. NCCN Breast Cancer v2.2026 elevated sacituzumab govitecan + pembrolizumab to category 1 preferred for CPS>=10 1L mTNBC on ASCENT-04, so KEYNOTE-355 chemo+pembro is now the alternative category 1 slot, not the lead one. Second, with a known BRCA1 finding (germline status in-flight on target_validation, not absent), NCCN v2.2026 puts germline-BRCA-directed PARPi at category 1 preferred and says explicitly that it can start before PD-L1 testing resolves; omitting olaparib/talazoparib from the rank list entirely sits outside the guideline-endorsed sequence for this exact patient.

Carbo/gem at rank 4 is the CPS<10 contingency the critic frames honestly as TNT-class evidence with a small BRCA-mut subgroup; the guideline-fit gap is the Feb 27 2026 NCCN update. NCCN Breast Cancer v2.2026 elevated sacituzumab govitecan monotherapy to category 1 preferred 1L for CPS<10 / ICI-ineligible mTNBC on ASCENT-03, which sits above platinum doublets in the current consensus stack, and ASCENT-03 enrolled BRCA-mutated patients so the BRCA1 finding does not park the patient outside the SG monotherapy population. Carbo/gem stays a defensible category 2A backbone; ranking it as the CPS<10 lead reads past the elevation.

Off-label in 1L US TNBC, and NCCN Breast Cancer v2.2026 plus ESMO ABC guidance both list germline-BRCA-directed PARPi monotherapy as category 1 preferred 1L for this patient, not PARPi+ICI combination. KEYLYNK-009 negative-overall with a CI-crossing-1 BRCA subgroup is exactly the data the consensus seat reads as 'not enough to displace the category 1 monotherapy.' Trial enrollment is the guideline-aligned route for the PARPi+ICI hypothesis, and there is no actively recruiting registered slot for the MEDIOLA-style switch in 1L US TNBC, so the rank 2 position is asking for the off-label combination rather than the on-trial pathway.

Targeting advocate rank 3 because the rank 1 (TROPION-Breast05) is where we agree. Single-agent olaparib leaves the TIL-3+/TMB-14/MYC-amp axes idle in a patient whose phenotype is the canonical PARPi+ICI responder; MEDIOLA pmid:32771088 (ORR 63%, DCR 80%) and TOPACIO pmid:31194225 (47% ORR in BRCA-mut TNBC) argue for a combination strategy even on subset/single-arm evidence. The advocate's tolerability framing (oral, low-footprint) trades the multi-hit upside for a comfort margin she did not ask for at efficacy weight 0.7.

If she draws KEYNOTE-355 off-trial she gets the TROPION-Breast05 (nct:NCT06103864) control arm without the experimental TROP2-ADC shot; that is a wasted enrollment slot for a patient with prefers_trials true and a 1.5 cm solitary liver lesion that is consolidatable. The conservative seat also explicitly omits SBRT consolidation (NCT05534438) and ZEN-3694 for a 42-year-old whose preference file flags curative-intent framing in the free text — the safety-first ordering is reading preferences that were not written. TROPION-Breast02 pmid:40297626 PFS HR 0.57 is exactly the kind of registrational signal the conservative pyramid should credit, not demote.

Single-agent PARPi as rank 1 collapses BRCA1 + TP53 + PTEN-loss + MYC-amp + TIL-3+ + TMB-14 down to one axis. The critic's veto list explicitly demotes MEDIOLA pmid:32771088 and TOPACIO pmid:31194225 as single-arm and post-hoc subsets, but the APOBEC-flavored BRCA1+ICI-favorable subset is exactly the population where the response lives (pmid:35168954) — three independent hits on the same hypothesis is not noise. The RoB 2 pyramid is the right frame for off-label payer fights, not for ranking a 42-year-old's 1L bet when the dossier hands you a multi-hit phenotype.

NCCN v2.2026 cannot have absorbed TROPION-Breast05 yet because the trial is still enrolling (nct:NCT06103864), so deferring to the consensus stack here writes off the highest-expected-value slot in the dossier on a technicality of publication lag. The consensus seat is also using E2108/NRG-BR002 (pmid:34995128, pmid:33885704) to argue against consolidation in a patient whose oligometastatic biology was not what either trial was powered to test — a solitary 1.5 cm liver lesion in a 42-year-old with BRCA1+ TNBC is the subset the negative trial could not detect benefit in. Meaningful PFS gains matter to a young-adult patient with curative-intent framing in her preference file; OS as the sole valid endpoint is a posture, not a guideline.
